patterns.note: Content is presented in large, centered blocks with generous vertical spacing, often featuring a prominent heading and a central interactive element or placeholder.

A high-contrast palette of dark backgrounds and light text is consistently used, dramatically offset by vibrant, abstract, and often glitchy full-bleed background graphics that define each section's mood.
A single, bold sans-serif typeface is used across all text, with significant size and weight variations to establish a clear hierarchy, from oversized headings to smaller, uppercase labels.
Content sections are revealed with scroll-triggered animations, where text blocks and associated elements appear to fade in or slide up into view as they enter the viewport.
Each major content section is visually anchored by a distinct, full-bleed abstract background graphic that changes or evolves, providing a unique visual identity and flow through the page.

technique_notes: A full-bleed, abstract video or animated graphic serves as the primary background for the hero section and potentially other sections, creating a dynamic and immersive visual experience (detected: video-hero).
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where text blocks and interactive elements appear with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as the user scrolls down the page.
A sticky or fixed call-to-action card appears at the bottom of the page, overlaying the background content, providing a persistent conversion point.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold headings (e.g., ~4-5x body text) with generous letter spacing create a strong visual impact, while body text remains legible and well-spaced.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on interactive elements like buttons and cards).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (very generous vertical spacing between sections and content blocks, contributing to a minimal and uncluttered feel).

standout: The site's distinctive use of abstract, glitch-art inspired, full-bleed animated backgrounds creates a highly immersive and unique visual experience that elevates simple content blocks. This dynamic, almost generative art aesthetic sets it apart from typical corporate or tech sites, making the page feel like a living canvas.
